prompt_text: I need a personal injury lawyer in Columbus after a car accident. Which specific law firms should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Columbus Ohio for a car accident case?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — before I give specific names, a couple quick questions to make sure my recommendations fit your needs:

- Are you in Columbus, Ohio (city zip or neighborhood helps)?  
- How serious were the injuries (minor, moderate, severe/permanent)?  
- Do you have any preference (big firm vs. local boutique, trial-focused, bilingual, budget concerns)?  
- Do you already have an insurer or adjuster contacting you?

If you want names right now, I can do one of two things:
- Option A: give a short list of well-regarded Columbus personal-injury firms to call plus why each is worth calling (best if you confirm Columbus, OH), or
- Option B: skip firm names and instead give a ready-to-use phone script and a prioritized checklist of questions to ask every firm so you can evaluate any attorney you call.

Which would you prefer? If you pick Option A, tell me your zip/neighborhood and injury severity and I’ll give specific firm recommendations and the key reasons to call each.
session_note: run_channel caveat: API results can differ from logged-in consumer apps, no memory, no personalization.
